question: Missing Data Art

defaults.field: How can end-to-end automation of AI research be realised? Build it, and measure where it breaks.
defaults.atelier: How can AI and automation meaningfully support artistic research?
defaults.studio: Take the Atlas of Data Art as a source of inspiration and build works, investigations or instruments with a unique selling point of their own: never copy an idea or a concept, but make something new, or take an existing work further, or carry it into a new context. The siblings' research material remains material.
